mapper.sql: SELECT 'RESOURCE' AS type, r.id AS id, r.title, r.review_status AS status, r.chapter_id AS chapterId, r.version_label AS versionLabel, r.source_name AS sourceName, r.file_path AS sourcePath, NULL AS parentId, NULL AS sourceType, NULL AS sourceRef, NULL AS contentHash, r.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM resources r

SELECT 'KNOWLEDGE_CHUNK' AS type, k.id AS id, k.title, k.review_status AS status, k.chapter_id AS chapterId, '' AS versionLabel, '' AS sourceName, k.source_path AS sourcePath, k.resource_id AS parentId, NULL AS sourceType, NULL AS sourceRef, NULL AS contentHash, k.created_at AS updatedAt FROM knowledge_chunks k

SELECT 'PRESENTATION_MANIFEST' AS type, p.id AS id, p.title, p.review_status AS status, p.chapter_id AS chapterId, p.version_label AS versionLabel, p.source_name AS sourceName, p.source_path AS sourcePath, p.resource_id AS parentId, NULL AS sourceType, NULL AS sourceRef, p.content_hash AS contentHash, p.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM presentation_manifests p

SELECT 'PRESENTATION_PAGE' AS type, p.id AS id, p.title, p.review_status AS status, m.chapter_id AS chapterId, p.version_label AS versionLabel, m.source_name AS sourceName, p.source_ref AS sourcePath, p.manifest_id AS parentId, NULL AS sourceType, p.source_ref AS sourceRef, p.content_hash AS contentHash, p.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM presentation_pages p INNER JOIN presentation_manifests m ON m.id = p.manifest_id

SELECT 'DSVP_REQUEST_SNAPSHOT' AS type, d.id AS id, CONCAT('DSVP ', d.id) AS title, d.review_status AS status, m.chapter_id AS chapterId, d.version_label AS versionLabel, d.source_type AS sourceName, d.source_ref AS sourcePath, d.animation_record_id AS parentId, d.source_type AS sourceType, d.source_ref AS sourceRef, d.request_hash AS contentHash, d.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM dsvp_request_snapshots d INNER JOIN presentation_pages p ON d.source_type = 'PPT' AND p.source_ref = d.source_ref INNER JOIN presentation_manifests m ON m.id = p.manifest_id
mapper.select: SELECT 'CHAPTER' AS type, id, title, status FROM chapters WHERE id = #{id}

choose.when: UPDATE resources SET review_status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE knowledge_chunks SET review_status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE presentation_manifests SET review_status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE presentation_pages SET review_status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE dsvp_request_snapshots SET review_status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}

mapper.select: SELECT id, previous_status AS previousStatus, next_status AS nextStatus, note, reviewer_user_id AS reviewerUserId, request_id AS requestId, created_at AS createdAt FROM content_review_events WHERE content_type = #{type} AND content_id = #{id} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
